svg.title: One city. Three economic layers.
svg.desc: Three separate layers: game cash earned and spent in play; fixed-supply OMR used through the supported market; and treasury-purchased Stock Tokens delivered only to eligible equipped deeds. Cash cannot be exchanged back into OMR. Launch gates and death risk still apply. Implementation snapshot 30 OCT 2026. Prelaunch: deployment and activation are not verified by this diagram. Sources: src/rules.js; src/stockdeliver.js:86; omerta-contracts/src/market-v2/OmertaRestrictedOMRV2.sol:23.
svg.text: Game cash, OMR and Stock Tokens have different jobs.

g.text: Only equipped deeds and their stocks pass to a killer.

svg.text: Implementation snapshot. Deployment, funding and launch activation are separate checks.
